WITH account_volumes AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    SUM(t.amount) as total_volume,
    COUNT(*) as num_transactions
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_volume) as grand_total FROM account_volumes
)
SELECT 
  av.account_id,
  av.region,
  av.total_volume,
  av.num_transactions,
  av.total_volume * 1.0 / tv.grand_total as share
FROM account_volumes av
CROSS JOIN total_sum tv
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10
